name: quantinuum_h2_2
source: Quantinuum hardware-specifications repository (github.com/Quantinuum/quantinuum-hardware-specifications), notebooks/Emulator parameters.csv and Spec sheet parameters.csv, row H2-2 2024_12_06: p1 = 8e-05, p2 = 1.4e-03, dephasing_error = 5.3e-04, p_meas_0 = 9e-04, p_meas_1 = 1.8e-03. 56 qubits (qreg q[56] in the H2-2 benchmark circuits). Assumptions: dephasing_error is applied per qubit per two-qubit gate layer; the native entangler is an arbitrary-angle ZZ gate; Z rotations are virtual. Not included: leakage (1Q 1.2e-05, 2Q 4.3e-04 in the spec sheet), crosstalk, transport timing.
